Tie the normalized record to exact source bytes.
implementation: SHA-256 is verified and stored in source provenance.

implementation: Identifiers derive from source SHA, version, agency, and solicitation.

requirement: Preserve original values and do not infer material missing data.
implementation: original_values retains raw input; missing_fields and limitations are explicit.

implementation: Initial state is intake_validated with downstream fields empty.

requirement: Write append-only case_created and source_ingested audit events.
implementation: Two hash-chained audit events are generated.
validation: Audit schemas and chain checks pass.

validation: Implemented as fixed fail-closed source gate.
